versos.grego: Παῦλος καὶ Σιλουανὸς καὶ Τιμόθεος τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ Θεσσαλονικέων ἐν Θεῷ Πατρὶ καὶ Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Χριστῷ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη.

controles.web: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: Paul, and Silvanus, and Timotheus, unto the church of the Thessalonians which is in God the Father and in the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Paulo, Silvano, e Timóteo, à igreja dos tessalonicenses, em Deus Pai, e no Senhor Jesus Cristo; haja convosco a graça e a paz.

versos.grego: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ πάντοτε περὶ πάντων ὑμῶν, μνείαν ποιούμενοι ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν ἡμῶν, ἀδιαλείπτως

controles.web: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,
controles.kjv: We give thanks to God always for you all, making mention of you in our prayers;
controles.livre: Sempre damos graças a Deus por todos vós, fazendo menção de vós em nossas orações.

versos.grego: μνημονεύοντες ὑμῶν τοῦ ἔργου τῆς πίστεως καὶ τοῦ κόπου τῆς ἀγάπης καὶ τῆς ὑπομονῆς τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν,

controles.web: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.
controles.kjv: Remembering without ceasing your work of faith, and labour of love, and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, in the sight of God and our Father;
controles.livre: E, diante do nosso Deus e Pai, nós nos lembramos sem cessar da obra da vossa fé, do trabalho do amor, e da firmeza da esperança no nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: εἰδότες, ἀδελφοὶ ἠγαπημένοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ, τὴν ἐκλογὴν ὑμῶν,

controles.web: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,
controles.kjv: Knowing, brethren beloved, your election of God.
controles.livre: Sabemos, irmãos amados por Deus, que por ele fostes escolhidos,

versos.grego: ὅτι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγενήθη εἰς ὑμᾶς ἐν λόγῳ μόνον, ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐν δυνάμει καὶ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ καὶ πληροφορίᾳ πολλῇ, καθὼς οἴδατε οἷοι ἐγενήθημεν ἐν ὑμῖν δι’ ὑμᾶς.

controles.web: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.
controles.kjv: For our gospel came not unto you in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Ghost, and in much assurance; as ye know what manner of men we were among you for your sake.
controles.livre: pois o nosso evangelho não foi até vós somente com palavras, mas também com poder, com o Espírito Santo, e com plena certeza; assim como sabeis de que maneira estivemos entre vós para o vosso benefício.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμεῖς μιμηταὶ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθητε καὶ τοῦ Κυρίου, δεξάμενοι τὸν λόγον ἐν θλίψει πολλῇ μετὰ χαρᾶς Πνεύματος Ἁγίου,

controles.web: You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,
controles.kjv: And ye became followers of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Ghost:
controles.livre: E vos tornastes imitadores nossos e do Senhor. Mesmo em meio a muita aflição, recebestes a palavra com a alegria do Espírito Santo.

versos.grego: ὥστε γενέσθαι ὑμᾶς τύπον πᾶσιν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ ἐν τῇ Ἀχαΐᾳ.

controles.web: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.
controles.kjv: So that ye were ensamples to all that believe in Macedonia and Achaia.
controles.livre: Dessa maneira vos tornastes referência a todos os crentes na Macedônia e Acaia.

versos.grego: ἀφ’ ὑμῶν γὰρ ἐξήχηται ὁ λόγος τοῦ Κυρίου οὐ μόνον ἐν τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ καὶ Ἀχαΐᾳ, ἀλλ’ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἡ πίστις ὑμῶν ἡ πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ἐξελήλυθεν, ὥστε μὴ χρείαν ἔχειν ἡμᾶς λαλεῖν τι·

controles.web: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.
controles.kjv: For from you sounded out the word of the Lord not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith to God-ward is spread abroad; so that we need not to speak any thing.
controles.livre: Pois de vós ressoou a palavra do Senhor, não somente na Macedônia e Acaia, mas a vossa fé em Deus se espalhou em todo lugar, de tal maneira que não precisamos falar coisa alguma.

versos.grego: αὐτοὶ γὰρ περὶ ἡμῶν ἀπαγγέλλουσιν ὁποίαν εἴσοδον ἔσχομεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς, καὶ πῶς ἐπεστρέψατε πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν ἀπὸ τῶν εἰδώλων δουλεύειν Θεῷ ζῶντι καὶ ἀληθινῷ,

controles.web: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you; and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,
controles.kjv: For they themselves shew of us what manner of entering in we had unto you, and how ye turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God;
controles.livre: Pois eles mesmos anunciam como fomos recebidos por vós,  e como vos convertestes, deixando os ídolos, para servir ao Deus vivo e verdadeiro;

versos.grego: καὶ ἀναμένειν τὸν Υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐκ τῶν οὐρανῶν, ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, Ἰησοῦν τὸν ῥυόμενον ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ὀργῆς τῆς ἐρχομένης.

controles.web: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead—Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
controles.kjv: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
controles.livre: e para esperar dos céus o seu Filho, a quem ele ressuscitou dos mortos: Jesus, que nos livra da ira futura.
